Dr David Morgenstern: head of the department of sports medicine and arthroscopy

Professional overview:
Dr David Morgenstern, a well-known Israeli trauma and orthopaedic surgeon and chief physician of a sports medicine centre, is a leading specialist in orthopaedics, arthroscopy and sports medicine. Having taken a master's degree in healthcare, Professor Morgenstern was the first among sports medicine doctors to receive accreditation from the Israeli scientific council.

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Arthroscopy (diagnostic and therapeutic) of the hip and knee joints
  • Hip replacement
  • Bone grafting
  • Repair of the soft tissues of the joint (nerves, tendons)
  • Rehabilitation after injury and after surgery

Education and clinical experience:

  • Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv, specialising in orthopaedics.
  • Fellowship at a medical centre in Colorado, USA, in hip arthroscopy.
  • Heads the department of sports medicine and arthroscopy at a private clinic in Israel.
  • Director of the sports medicine centre at a hospital complex.
  • Senior orthopaedic surgeon in the arthroscopy unit of the sports injury service.

Academic experience:
Dr Morgenstern is actively engaged in developing systems for recovery after injury and is the author of many publications on sports injury and rehabilitation. He speaks regularly at international medical conferences and has been recognised by the University of Warwick in the United Kingdom for his pioneering work in hip arthroscopy.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Member of the Israel Medical Association.
  • Member of the Israel Orthopaedic Association.
  • Member of the Israel Sports Medicine Association.
  • Member of the international college of hip arthroscopy.

Languages:
Dr Morgenstern speaks English, Hebrew, Spanish and French, which allows him to communicate with patients and colleagues from around the world.

Dr David Morgenstern is recognised in Israel and beyond for his contribution to sports medicine and arthroscopy, offering innovative approaches to the treatment and rehabilitation of athletes and of patients with orthopaedic conditions.

Dr David Raderman is a leading specialist in plastic surgery in Israel

Specialisation:

  • Reconstructive and aesthetic operations in plastic surgery
  • Main areas: breast surgery, abdominoplasty, liposuction, rhinoplasty, scar removal, neck and facial surgery, and much else.

Education:

  • Graduated from the faculty of medicine, University of Bologna, Italy
  • Specialisation in the plastic surgery department of the Rabin medical centre
  • Advanced training abroad at leading medical institutions in the United States and Europe.

Clinical and academic experience:

  • More than 25 years working in plastic surgery
  • Began as a plastic surgeon at the Rabin medical centre and went on to head its plastic surgery department.

Professional associations:

  • Israel Society of Plastic Surgeons
  • American Society of Plastic Surgeons
  • Israel Association of Plastic Surgery

Dr Dean Ad-El is a plastic surgeon specialising in reconstructive operations after burns.

Specialisation:

  • Plastic surgery of the breast, head and neck
  • Reconstructive operations after burns

Education:

  • Graduated from the Technion, the Israel Institute of Technology, in 1988 (faculty of medicine)
  • Served as a military surgeon in the Israeli army from 1989 to 1992; after completing his studies he specialised at the Hadassah medical centre
  • Trained abroad at the Sloan Kettering clinic, USA, in breast surgery and microsurgery

Academic and clinical experience:

  • In 1998 became head of the department of microsurgery and breast plastic surgery at the Hadassah clinic
  • Since 2004 has held the post of head of the plastic surgery department at the Rabin Medical Centre
  • Alongside his clinical practice, Dr Ad-El teaches and lectures at Tel Aviv University
  • Takes an active part in international conferences, contributing to the search for new methods in plastic surgery

Membership of professional associations:

  • Israeli, European and American associations of plastic surgery
  • International society of microsurgeons
  • International society of aesthetic surgery
  • Chairman of the Israel society of microsurgery

Plastic surgeon

Main areas of specialisation

  • Microsurgery
  • Reconstruction of the tissues of the head
  • Neck surgery
  • Rhinoplasty
  • Facelift
  • Blepharoplasty
  • Otoplasty
  • Breast augmentation, reduction and correction

Summary

Dr Amir Aaron is an outstanding specialist in aesthetic and plastic surgery, known for his skill in performing complex reconstructive operations, particularly on the head, neck and breast. His many years of experience and high professionalism draw patients from all corners of the world. Dr Aaron is the author and co-author of more than 30 papers published in leading medical journals.

Education and clinical experience

  • School of Medicine, Tel Aviv University
  • Fellowship at the Soroka hospital, Beersheba
  • Specialisation in plastic surgery at Canniesburn hospital, Scotland

Languages

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations

  • Israel Society of Plastic Surgery
  • American Society for Reconstructive Microsurgery
  • American Society of Plastic Surgeons
  • Head of the licensing commission for plastic surgeons in the Israel association of plastic surgeons

Dr Amir Aaron is a name associated with professionalism and high quality in plastic and reconstructive surgery. He is a leading specialist who not only performs operations but also takes an active part in research, introducing innovative techniques and improving outcomes for his patients.

Dr Amir Kramer is a well-known cardiac surgeon in Israel and one of the three leading specialists in the country in his field. His experience includes thousands of successful heart operations in patients of all ages; one of Dr Kramer's patients was 90 years old at the time of surgery. In his practice he uses every modern method of minimally invasive surgery, including valve repair and replacement and myocardial revascularisation in coronary artery disease.

Amir Kramer is a graduate of the Pirogov Second Medical Institute in Moscow and completed a fellowship at the Bakulev Scientific Centre for Cardiovascular Surgery in Moscow. After moving to Israel he began his career at the Ichilov hospital in Tel Aviv, and has also undertaken fellowships in the United Kingdom, Denmark and Germany.

Specialisation:

  • Cardiology
  • Cardiac surgery
  • Cardiovascular operations
  • Coronary artery bypass grafting
  • Minimally invasive heart operations
  • Heart valve replacement
  • Treatment of coronary artery disease

Professional activity:

  • Leading cardiac surgeon in the cardiothoracic surgery department of the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv
  • Cardiothoracic surgeon at the Assuta clinic, Tel Aviv
  • Consulting practice at the private Ramat Aviv clinic, Tel Aviv
  • Member of professional associations of cardiac surgeons in Israel

Research work:

  • Teacher of cardiology in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University
  • Author of dozens of research publications in leading international journals on cardiothoracic surgery

Languages:

  • Russian
  • English
  • Hebrew

Specialisation: gynaecological oncology

Main areas of specialisation:

Dr Anna Blecher is a leading specialist in gynaecological oncology. She has considerable experience in the diagnosis and treatment of gynaecological cancers, including surgery and colposcopy.

  • Gynaecological oncology
  • Surgical treatment of gynaecological tumours
  • Colposcopy
  • Diagnosis and treatment of cervical cancer
  • Ovarian cancer
  • Endometrial cancer
  • Vulvar cancer

Summary:

Dr Anna Blecher is a leading gynaecological oncologist with many years of experience at major medical centres in Israel and Canada. She is actively engaged in both clinical and research work, introducing the newest methods of diagnosing and treating cancer. Dr Blecher also heads the colposcopy clinic at the Sheba Medical Centre.

Education and clinical experience:

  • 2010-2011: School of continuing medical education in obstetrics and gynaecology, Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • 1999-2003: Doctor of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Israel
  • 1996-1999: Bachelor of Medical Sciences, Tel Aviv University, Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Israel

Professional experience:

  • 2020 to the present: Gynaecologist, gynaecological oncology department, Sheba Medical Centre, Tel HaShomer, Israel
    • Head of the colposcopy clinic, gynaecological oncology department, Sheba Medical Centre, Tel HaShomer, Israel
    • Gynaecological oncology surgeon, Assuta Medical Centre, Ramat HaHayal, Tel Aviv; Rafael Medical Centre; TLV Medical Centre
  • 2018-2020: Clinical fellowship in gynaecological oncology, University of Toronto, Canada. The programme is accredited by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada; work at Toronto General and Sunnybrook hospitals, the Princess Margaret Cancer Centre and the Odette Cancer Centre.
  • 2017-2018: Gynaecologist, gynaecological oncology department, Sheba Medical Centre, Tel HaShomer, Israel
  • 2010-2017: Resident, department of obstetrics and gynaecology, Hillel Yaffe Medical Centre, Hadera, Israel. Graduated with distinction.
  • 2016-2017: Basic science research, department of human molecular genetics and biochemistry, Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • 2015-2018: Gynaecological surgeon, Assuta Medical Centre, Ramat Aviv, Israel
  • 2005-2016: Military service, Israel Defence Forces. From physician at a training base to head of the medical staff at recruitment centres. Discharged with the rank of major.
  • 2004-2005: Duty physician in the general surgery department, HaSharon Medical Centre, Petah Tikva, Israel
  • 2003-2004: Intern, HaSharon Medical Centre, Petah Tikva, Israel
  • 2000-2003: Intensive care assistant at NATALI, mobile intensive care service, Tel Aviv, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy
